<json>{

      "to": "SessionOpen"

    {

      "action": "send greeting",
      "to": "SessionOpen"
    },
    {

      "event": "receive MAIL FROM",
      "action": "reset state tables",
      "to": "MailTransaction"
    },
    {
      "from": "MailTransaction",
      "event": "receive RCPT TO",
      "action": "store forward-path",
      "to": "MailTransaction"
    },
    {
      "from": "MailTransaction",
      "event": "receive DATA",
      "action": "send 354 intermediate",
      "to": "DataTransfer"
    },
    {
      "from": "DataTransfer",
      "event": "receive end-of-data",
      "action": "process recipients and data",
      "to": "Terminated"
    },
    {
      "from": "MailTransaction",
      "event": "receive DATA (invalid)",
      "action": "send 503 or 554",
      "to": "SessionOpen"
    },
    {
      "from": "DataTransfer",
      "event": "receive failure",
      "action": "send 550",
      "to": "Terminated"
    },

      "event": "receive QUIT",
      "action": "send 221 and close",
      "to": "Initial"
